Leg Press.label: Leg Press
Leg Press.start: Set both feet flat on the plate.
Leg Press.finish: Press without snapping your knees straight.

Leg Extension.label: Leg Extension
Leg Extension.start: Line up your knees with the pivot.
Leg Extension.finish: Straighten your knees and keep your hips seated.

Squat.label: Squat
Squat.start: Set the bar on your upper back.
Squat.finish: Bend at the hips and knees; keep feet planted.

Goblet Squat.label: Goblet Squat
Goblet Squat.start: Hold the weight in front of your chest.
Goblet Squat.finish: Sit down between your hips with heels planted.

Hack Squat.label: Hack Squat
Hack Squat.start: Set your shoulders under the pads.
Hack Squat.finish: Lower on the rails, keeping feet on the platform.

Bulgarian Split Squat.label: Bulgarian Split Squat
Bulgarian Split Squat.start: Rest your rear foot on the bench.
Bulgarian Split Squat.finish: Lower your back knee while the front foot stays flat.

Walking Lunge.label: Walking Lunge
Walking Lunge.start: Take a step forward and plant the whole foot.
Walking Lunge.finish: Lower into the lunge, then step through.

Seated Leg Curl.label: Seated Leg Curl
Seated Leg Curl.start: Start with legs extended under the pads.
Seated Leg Curl.finish: Curl your heels down and back; keep thighs seated.

Deadlift.label: Deadlift
Deadlift.start: Start over the bar with it close to your shins.
Deadlift.finish: Stand tall with the bar close to your legs.

Standing Leg Curl.label: Standing Leg Curl
Standing Leg Curl.start: Brace on the machine with one leg supporting you.
Standing Leg Curl.finish: Bend the working knee to bring your heel back.

Romanian Deadlift.label: Romanian Deadlift
Romanian Deadlift.start: Start standing with the bar against your thighs.
Romanian Deadlift.finish: Hinge at the hips; keep a soft bend in your knees.

Lying Leg Curl.label: Lying Leg Curl
Lying Leg Curl.start: Lie face down with the roller above your heels.
Lying Leg Curl.finish: Curl your heels toward your hips.

Hip Thrust.label: Hip Thrust
Hip Thrust.start: Support your upper back and plant your feet.
Hip Thrust.finish: Lift your hips until your torso is level.

Glute Bridge.label: Glute Bridge
Glute Bridge.start: Lie back with knees bent and feet flat.
Glute Bridge.finish: Lift your hips while your shoulders stay down.

Cable Kickback.label: Cable Kickback
Cable Kickback.start: Attach the low cable to your working ankle.
Cable Kickback.finish: Move that leg back while keeping your hips square.

Step-Up.label: Step-Up
Step-Up.start: Place your whole lead foot on the box.
Step-Up.finish: Drive through that foot to stand on the box.

DB Bench Press.label: DB Bench Press
DB Bench Press.start: Lower the dumbbells beside your chest.
DB Bench Press.finish: Press above the chest with wrists over elbows.

Incline Chest Press.label: Incline Chest Press
Incline Chest Press.start: Set the handles near your upper chest.
Incline Chest Press.finish: Press up and forward along the machine's path.

Pec Deck.label: Pec Deck
Pec Deck.start: Open your arms with a slight elbow bend.
Pec Deck.finish: Bring the handles together without shrugging.

Barbell Bench Press.label: Barbell Bench Press
Barbell Bench Press.start: Lower the bar toward your mid-to-lower chest.
Barbell Bench Press.finish: Press upward until your arms are extended.

Incline DB Bench Press.label: Incline DB Bench Press
Incline DB Bench Press.start: Lower the dumbbells beside your upper chest.
Incline DB Bench Press.finish: Press up while keeping your back on the bench.

Push-Up.label: Push-Up
Push-Up.start: Start with a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Push-Up.finish: Lower your chest while maintaining that line.

Cable Fly.label: Cable Fly
Cable Fly.start: Start with arms open and elbows slightly bent.
Cable Fly.finish: Sweep the handles together in front of your chest.

Lat Pulldown.label: Lat Pulldown
Lat Pulldown.start: Reach for the bar with a wide grip.
Lat Pulldown.finish: Pull toward your upper chest, elbows down.

Chest-Supported Row.label: Chest-Supported Row
Chest-Supported Row.start: Support your chest and let the weights hang.
Chest-Supported Row.finish: Pull your elbows back and keep your chest on the pad.

Machine High Row.label: Machine High Row
Machine High Row.start: Start with your arms reaching up and forward.
Machine High Row.finish: Drive your elbows down and back toward your ribs.

Seated Cable Row.label: Seated Cable Row
Seated Cable Row.start: Reach forward without rounding your back.
Seated Cable Row.finish: Pull toward your lower ribs without rocking.

Pull-Up.label: Pull-Up
Pull-Up.finish: Pull until your chin clears the bar.

One-Arm DB Row.label: One-Arm DB Row
One-Arm DB Row.start: Brace on the bench and let the dumbbell hang.
One-Arm DB Row.finish: Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, torso steady.

Lateral Raise.label: Lateral Raise
Lateral Raise.start: Start with dumbbells at your sides.
Lateral Raise.finish: Raise out to the sides to about shoulder height.

DB Shoulder Press.label: DB Shoulder Press
DB Shoulder Press.start: Start with dumbbells at shoulder height.

Machine Shoulder Press.label: Machine Shoulder Press
Machine Shoulder Press.start: Set the handles slightly above shoulder level.
Machine Shoulder Press.finish: Press overhead while staying against the pad.

Barbell Overhead Press.label: Barbell Overhead Press
Barbell Overhead Press.start: Start with the bar at the front of your shoulders.
Barbell Overhead Press.finish: Press overhead and finish over your midfoot.

Front Raise.label: Front Raise
Front Raise.start: Start with the weight in front of your thighs.
Front Raise.finish: Raise it in front of you to shoulder height.

Reverse Pec Deck.label: Reverse Pec Deck
Reverse Pec Deck.start: Face the pad and start with handles in front.
Reverse Pec Deck.finish: Move your arms outward while keeping your chest supported.

Face Pull.label: Face Pull
Face Pull.start: Reach toward the rope at face height.
Face Pull.finish: Pull toward your face, hands beside your head.

Bent-Over Rear Delt Fly.label: Bent-Over Rear Delt Fly
Bent-Over Rear Delt Fly.start: Hinge forward and let the weights hang.
Bent-Over Rear Delt Fly.finish: Raise both arms out, keeping your torso steady.

DB Curl.label: DB Curl
DB Curl.start: Let the dumbbell hang with palm facing forward.
DB Curl.finish: Curl by bending the elbow; keep your upper arm still.

Hammer Curl.label: Hammer Curl
Hammer Curl.start: Hold the dumbbell with your thumb pointing forward.
Hammer Curl.finish: Curl with the thumb up and keep the elbow still.

Preacher Curl.label: Preacher Curl
Preacher Curl.start: Rest your upper arm on the angled pad.
Preacher Curl.finish: Curl while maintaining contact with the pad.

EZ-Bar Curl.label: EZ-Bar Curl
EZ-Bar Curl.start: Stand tall with the EZ bar in front of your thighs.
EZ-Bar Curl.finish: Curl the bar without swinging your shoulders.

Cable Curl.label: Cable Curl
Cable Curl.start: Face the low pulley with elbows by your sides.
Cable Curl.finish: Curl the handle while keeping your elbows steady.

Incline DB Curl.label: Incline DB Curl
Incline DB Curl.start: Sit against the incline bench and let your arms hang.
Incline DB Curl.finish: Curl without bringing your upper arm forward.

Triceps Pushdown.label: Triceps Pushdown
Triceps Pushdown.start: Keep your elbows by your sides and grip the handle.
Triceps Pushdown.finish: Straighten your elbows toward the floor.

Triceps Dip Machine.label: Triceps Dip Machine
Triceps Dip Machine.start: Sit tall with the handles near your hips.
Triceps Dip Machine.finish: Press the handles down while keeping your shoulders steady.

Overhead Cable Extension.label: Overhead Cable Extension
Overhead Cable Extension.start: Face away from the pulley with hands behind your head.
Overhead Cable Extension.finish: Straighten your elbows overhead without flaring them.

Skull Crusher.label: Skull Crusher
Skull Crusher.start: Hold the EZ bar above your shoulders while lying down.
Skull Crusher.finish: Bend at the elbows to lower the bar behind your forehead.

Close-Grip Bench Press.label: Close-Grip Bench Press
Close-Grip Bench Press.start: Lower with hands roughly shoulder-width apart.
Close-Grip Bench Press.finish: Press upward with elbows closer to your sides.

Calf Raise.label: Calf Raise
Calf Raise.start: Stand on the edge with heels lowered under control.
Calf Raise.finish: Rise onto the balls of both feet.

Seated Calf Raise.label: Seated Calf Raise
Seated Calf Raise.start: Set the pad above the knees with heels lowered.
Seated Calf Raise.finish: Raise your heels while your thighs stay under the pad.

Standing Calf Raise.label: Standing Calf Raise
Standing Calf Raise.start: Place your shoulders under the machine pads.
Standing Calf Raise.finish: Lift your heels while keeping knees nearly straight.

Single-Leg Calf Raise.label: Single-Leg Calf Raise
Single-Leg Calf Raise.start: Balance on one foot with your free foot lifted.
Single-Leg Calf Raise.finish: Raise the working heel without rolling the ankle.

Cable Crunch.label: Cable Crunch
Cable Crunch.start: Kneel with the rope close to your head.
Cable Crunch.finish: Curl your ribs toward your hips, keeping the rope in place.

Hanging Knee Raise.label: Hanging Knee Raise
Hanging Knee Raise.start: Hang from the bar with legs down.
Hanging Knee Raise.finish: Curl upward and bring bent knees toward your chest.

Reverse Crunch.label: Reverse Crunch
Reverse Crunch.start: Lie down with hips and knees bent.
Reverse Crunch.finish: Curl your pelvis up and bring knees toward your chest.

Ab Wheel Rollout.label: Ab Wheel Rollout
Ab Wheel Rollout.start: Kneel with the wheel below your shoulders.
Ab Wheel Rollout.finish: Roll forward as far as you can keep your trunk braced.
